react_native_issues.issue: Console warning (non-blocking): '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted repeatedly on web preview from multiple components using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Emitted on /settings and /login. Likely from a third-party wrapper (FadeInView / lucide) — non-blocking.
Console warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Expected on web preview only; irrelevant on native iOS/Android builds.

rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration verified fixes for the iOS provisioning-profile mismatch and deployment-health blockers. Both have been removed from app.json; the expo-apple-authentication npm package remains installed but the login screen only shows the Apple button when `Platform.OS === 'ios' && AppleAuthentication.isAvailableAsync()` — verified in code and via web render (button absent). Build should now pass EAS provisioning validation.
